directories.docs: Contains 4 module files (routing-policy.md, workflow.md, workflow-tracing-proposal.md, validation.md)

config/policy.json.summary: This configuration file defines model routing policies, aliases, role-based model assignments, and execution limits. It manages model selection and fallback behavior across the project.

docs/routing-policy.md.summary: This documentation file defines the subagent routing policy and model tiers for delegated tasks. It serves as the authoritative specification for project-wide subagent model selection.

README.md.summary: This project documentation file outlines the OpenCode quota-aware subagent router for OpenCode 2.x. It details system components, routing policies, and local MCP tools used to manage subagent execution and quotas.

docs/workflow.md.summary: `docs/workflow.md` documents local workflow tracing, its recorded metadata, privacy limits, and task semantics. It defines no exported functions or classes; it guides local inspection of router workflow data.

docs/workflow-tracing-proposal.md.summary: `docs/workflow-tracing-proposal.md` documents workflow tracing’s design goals, existing infrastructure, and proposed data model; it has no exported functions or classes and serves as a design reference.

docs/validation.md.summary: Documents local validation results for the router, Antigravity adapter, quota service, and Observatory, including tests, typechecks, builds, and audit findings. It records test-safety details and handoff context; it exports no functions or classes.

package.json.summary: The `package.json` file defines project metadata, dependencies, and scripts for the `opencode-model-router` project. It configures the Bun runtime, TypeScript environment, and CLI entry points.

plugin/guard.ts.summary: This file intercepts and validates AI SDK language model calls against active router executions. It exports `guardLanguage` to wrap and secure `LanguageModelV3` instances within the project.

plugin/index.ts.summary: This file defines the core OpenCode plugin entry point, exporting `routingSchema` and `subagentInput` to configure and register plugin workflows and routing parameters.

scripts/bind-credentials.ts.summary: This script binds approved OpenCode credentials to project configurations by updating `credentialBindings` with verified IDs and fingerprints. It serves as an administrative setup utility to secure local development credentials.

plugin/workflow.ts.summary: `workflow.ts` defines `workflowTools`, which registers the `workflow_annotate` tool to asynchronously send workflow events to the router client. It integrates LLM agent sessions with backend workflows.

scripts/concurrency-probe.ts.summary: `scripts/concurrency-probe.ts` is a local-only CLI script that probes execution concurrency by running test tasks across specified hierarchy levels. It acts as an internal diagnostic tool bypassing standard MCP routing.
